 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Amit Sharma
 Order

The present petition under Section 482 of the Cr.P.C. seeks quashing of FIR No.
602/2019 under Sections 498A/406/34 of the IPC, registered at P.S. Khajuri Khas, Delhi.

Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the matter has been settled with respondent no.
2/complainant before Smt. Rakhi Gill, Principal Counsellor, North East District, Karkardooma,
Delhi.
In pursuance thereof, respondent no.2/complainant has no objection if the present FIR being quashed.
Learned APP for the State accepts notice and seeks time to file the status report.
Let the status report with regard to the demise of Ms. Najbunnisha (mother-in-law of the complainant), be filed before the next date of hearing.
